messages:
Sam: Thanks everyone — quick live follow-up from the all-hands incident section. Posting links and action items here so we can close loops.
Alex: appreciate it. can we start with the RCA link?
Sam: RCA here: https://docs.redwood.com/incidents/2026-11-02-global-hpa-failure (internal) — TL;DR: autoscaler bug + sudden traffic pattern + cache warming gap.
Maria: copied. I skimmed — looks like we missed a metric window that would have flagged the pattern earlier.
Devin: created a short checklist for immediate mitigations: 1) tighten HPA threshold, 2) add prewarmed pools, 3) alert on cache TTL churn. PRs incoming.
Raj: @Devin can you drop the PR numbers? want to track in sprint board.
Devin: PRs: #5421 (hpa-fix), #5423 (prewarm-pool), #5427 (alerting). I'll link them in the ticket.
Emily: For customers impacted — is support sending out notes or are we waiting for legal sign-off?
Sam: Support draft is in #support with suggested wording. Legal saw the draft; final sign-off expected by EOD. @Emily please coordinate.
Thomas: noted missing telemetry — we didn't have per-route kv-cache eviction metrics for the beta rollout. adding that to action list
SRE Bot: incident-2026-11-02 RCA posted by @Alex. Auto-tagging owners: pagers: @Raj, runbook: runbook/repo#23.
Alex: Action owners I propose: Devin (HPA thresholds), Thomas (cache telemetry), Maria (dashboard + runbook updates), Raj (postmortem write-up + customer impact summary), Emily (customer comms). Agree?
Maria: agree. I'll add dashboard mocks to the ticket and ping design for a quick panel.
Raj: I'll prepare a concise summary for sales & CSMs. ETA tomorrow 11:00 PT.
Devin: starting work on PR #5421 today, aiming for review by tomorrow noon.
Emily: coordinating support comms now. expect outbound template by 6pm PT.
Sam: two asks for leadership: 1) approve a one-week guardrail to lower autoscaler aggressiveness in prod (nonbreaking), 2) greenlight dev time for cache telemetry next sprint. Approvals?
Alex: +1 for both. lowering aggressiveness helps while we validate.
Maria: +1. spending a tiny bit of dev time now will save ops cycles.
Thomas: will prepare a small implementation plan for telemetry (estimate: 3 dev-days).
Devin: can do the hpa guardrail change in a maintenance window tonight if ops approves.
SRE Bot: scheduled maintenance window request submitted to calendar: maintenance/2026-11-04-22:00-23:00 PT.
Sam: thumbs-up. final ask: owners please drop confirmation messages here when tasks are complete. I'll follow up in next standup to make sure nothing slips.
Raj: will post summary + customers list when done.
Maria: dashboard PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/2107
Devin: PR #5421 merged at 1854002800. rolling out to canary.
Thomas: telemetry branch pushed: feature/cache-metrics, request review from @Alex.
Emily: support comms sent to affected customers at 1854003000.
Alex: canary looks healthy so far, no regressions in 30m. keeping watch.
Sam: thank you all. will close this thread after confirmations. if anyone needs help with blockers ping me directly. :heart:
